title: Cambodian Waffles (Num Poum)
hookLine: Global-inspired cambodian waffles (num poum) with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cook on Hot Iron Until Crisp
steps.instructionTemplate: In a bowl, mix the flour, coconut milk, palm sugar and eggs and salt. Brush a waffle iron with oil pour in the batter and cook over an open fire until light brown and crispy. Incorporate {m53420_1}, {m53420_2}, and {m53420_3} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure rice flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53420_4}, {m53420_5}, and {m53420_6} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Check Consistency & Fold Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently fold the mixture from the bottom up with a silicone spatula until completely smooth, glossy, and free of any pockets or streaks before moving to the final chill or bake.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {m53420_4}, {m53420_5}, and {m53420_6}. Serve Cambodian Waffles (Num Poum) fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
